summary: Targeted fix for the TypeScript build error in app/api/item-listing-crud/route.ts, where the sort comparator indexes the item object with a plain string-typed 'sort' variable. The fix defines an explicit union type of sortable keys (e.g. 'name' | 'price' | 'quantity' | 'category' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'), validates/casts the incoming sort query parameter against that union before using it to index items in a[sort]/b[sort] in both the if- and else-branches of the comparator, so the file type-checks cleanly. All other previously implemented files for this feature (models, frontend page, API client, home page nav link) are unchanged and are re-listed here only to preserve full requirement/entity/endpoint traceability for this already-verified feature -- no functional changes are made to them.

files.rationale: Fix TypeScript type error at the sort comparator by typing the sort key as a union of valid sortable item fields (e.g. `type SortKey = 'name' | 'price' | 'quantity' | 'category' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'`), validating the incoming sort query param against that union (falling back to a default like 'name' if invalid) before using it to index items in a[sort]/b[sort] on both comparator branches, so the collection GET/POST endpoints and item-level PUT/DELETE logic in this handler type-check and build successfully.
